description: This file defines the ApiException class within the SuiteCRM API v8 exceptions namespace. It extends the LangException class and provides mechanisms for custom exception handling, including additional details, source information, and HTTP status code management.

classes.name: ApiException
classes.description: Custom exception class for API errors, providing additional context and HTTP status management within the SuiteCRM v8 API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an ApiException instance with a message, code, previous exception, and optional language text.

methods.name: getDetail
methods.description: Returns detailed information about the exception, encapsulated in a LangText object.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets the detailed information for the exception using a LangText object.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source of the error, such as pointer or parameter, for debugging purposes.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source information associated with the exception.

methods.name: getHttpStatus
methods.description: Returns the HTTP status code that should be returned to the client when this exception occurs.
